evals.prompt: Set up my GTM config. My LinkedIn is https://www.linkedin.com/in/honglliu
evals.expected_output: A persona derived entirely from Crustdata enrichment: identity (name, title, company, tenure), what the company sells, an ICP explicitly labeled inferred, and voice + topics from recent posts. The persona is shown back for correction before config/persona-profile.md and config/gtm-config.md are written. Ends by suggesting sales-prospecting and account-research.
expectations: Calls person_enrich (via execute/callTool) with the LinkedIn URL and fields limited to basic_profile, experience, and social_handles, with no contact groups
Does not request contact field groups and does not set preview: true on person_enrich
Enriches the current company via company_enrich with fields basic_info and taxonomy, using the company id from the person's current employment or a free company_identify first
Calls social_post_list_live for the profile URL with an explicit limit of 10 or fewer
Does not ask the user what they sell, who their ICP is, or for writing samples before enriching
Labels the ICP section as inferred and shows the persona back for correction before writing files
Writes both config/persona-profile.md and config/gtm-config.md
Suggests sales-prospecting and account-research as next steps

evals.prompt: Get me started with the GTM skills. I don't have a Crustdata connection set up yet.
evals.expected_output: No enrichment attempted. The skill asks for 2-3 short lines (name and role, what the company does, who they sell to) instead of an interview, then writes both config files with the ICP labeled inferred, voice set to neutral, and skipped stack slots recorded as none.
expectations: Does not attempt any Crustdata tool call
Asks for at most 2-3 short inputs (name/role, what the company does, who it sells to), not a long questionnaire
Writes config/persona-profile.md and config/gtm-config.md from those lines
Records skipped stack tools as none and notes they run in draft-only mode
Sets the voice to neutral instead of inventing style notes
Labels the ICP as inferred

evals.expected_output: Summarizes the existing config supplied in the prompt in a couple of lines instead of silently overwriting it. Re-runs enrichment on the new URL, shows the refreshed persona for correction, updates both files, and carries the stack entries already in the config forward unchanged.
expectations: Summarizes the existing config supplied in the prompt (stack, ICP, voice) in one or two lines before making changes, instead of silently overwriting it
Carries the answered stack entries forward unchanged into the updated config: CRM: AcmeCRM, Email: MailCo, Team chat: ChatCo, and the none slots stay none

Labels the refreshed ICP as inferred

evals.prompt: Onboard me. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/topherc. Skip the stack questions, I'll connect tools later.
evals.expected_output: The stack question is skipped immediately with no per-tool re-asking; every stack slot is written as none with a draft-only note. The persona is still built from the URL via Crustdata, shown for correction, and both config files are written.
expectations: Honors the skip immediately and does not ask about any individual stack tool
Does not infer the stack from connected connectors
Writes every stack slot as none with a draft-only mode note
Still runs person_enrich, company enrichment, and social_post_list_live (limit 10 or fewer) for the persona
Shows the persona back for correction before writing files
Writes both config/persona-profile.md and config/gtm-config.md
